target_customer: Industrial buyers of precision machined parts, such as aerospace and robotics firms
problem: Precision parts took months to get and manufacturing was manual, slow and costly; the founder waited months for spare parts for a robot hand at OpenAI.
business_model: Vertically integrated contract manufacturing with an AI-driven production platform

founders.name: Jonas Schneider
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch Feb 2024: technical lead at OpenAI, helped launch robotics in 2016, led software engineering for over three years including the Rubik's Cube hand, left in 2019.

technical_complexity.rationale: Autonomous reconfigurable factories combine robotics, machining and software, and the company had to operate a real factory, which is hardware-heavy for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Owned factories and process know-how are hard to replicate quickly, though cost and capital intensity limit scaling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy or purchase was found in the sources opened; Xometry and Protolabs came up only via undated comparison pages.

market_need_then: The founder's firsthand experience of months-long waits for precision parts is cited in 2024 coverage; no 2020-dated demand data was opened.

branding.domain_note: daedalus.com returned a page titled Daedalus Applied Intelligence Laboratory with no company content, so it may not be this company; the company posts on a Substack.

brand_strength.rationale: Press focuses on the OpenAI link, not the brand; the name is shared with a Greek myth figure and many companies.

outcome_analysis: Daedalus raised an $11.5M seed in November 2021 and a $21M Series A in February 2024 led by NGP Capital, bringing reported funding past $40M. It runs a factory in Karlsruhe and was targeting more capacity. No distress or exit appears in sources found, so the later outcome is unknown.
notes: Seed date is from the company's own Substack post. Total of over $40M is stated by TechCrunch; one profile says $41.1M. The company site daedalus.com yielded no usable content. Competitor list left empty: only undated vendor and aggregator comparison pages were found. No outcome news after February 2024 was found for 2025 or later.
